pr_title: tools: doc: improve async workflow of generate.js
pr_body:
Use fs.promises for read and write file
Use unified().process wich is async instead processSync
html and json are write in parallel
errors are logged and exit process with `1` code

Fixes: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/30090

- [ ] `vcbuild test` (Windows) passes
- [x] commit message follows [commit guidelines](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/master/doc/guides/contributing/pull-requests.md#commit-message-guidelines)

I'm behind a corporate proxy and get some network errors during the tests, so I hope tests passes with the CI.

issue_context.title: Doctool may swallow errors due to unhandled async functions
issue_context.body:
Basically, this code is not good:

https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/5a042a6b1a9763be010c4614436b114f0d514561/tools/doc/generate.js#L70-L93

Issues with that:
- Async function set as a callback (unhandled)
- sync I/O calls inside an async function
- `unified` is synchronously invoked still

This is all the direct result of https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/f4f856b2381d10de48534e0de97df142f3e29994, which is the result of something else. In hindsight, I wish I payed a bit more attention in my review of that.

Unfortunately my focus is elsewhere, so someone else should probably try to clean this up.
